secrets.summary: The 2011 London riots in the UK are mentioned on the LS Benders radio commercial.

secrets.title: Marc Emery
secrets.area: References to Real Life People, Groups, and Events
secrets.summary: The character Barry is possibly based on Marc Emery. Both are marijuana advocates and share similarities in their likenesses.

secrets.title: Mark Zuckerberg/Steve Jobs
secrets.area: References to Real Life People, Groups, and Events
secrets.summary: Lifeinvader's founder, Jay Norris, appears to be based on Mark Zuckerberg and Steve Jobs, specifically the former for his likeness along with the fact he helped create Facebook (which Lifeinvader is a parody of), and the latter for the fact he started his company within his parents' garage – Norris having started his company within his parents' pool house.

secrets.title: Mary Celeste
secrets.area: References to Real Life People, Groups, and Events
secrets.summary: One of the possible choices for a goal on Vinewood Logline Generator is "To uncover the truth about what really happened to the Marie [sic] Celeste", referencing the merchant brigantine Mary Celeste, which in 1872 was discovered drifting unmanned near the Azores - its crew having mysteriously disappeared.

secrets.title: Miami Cannibal
secrets.area: References to Real Life People, Groups, and Events
secrets.summary: Bath salts and cannibalism were mentioned in a radio segment advertising toilet cleaner, which is a reference to the Miami cannibal attack, where a man suspected to be on bath salts attacked another man and bit off most of his face.

secrets.title: Minutemen Project/Minuteman Civil Defense Corps
secrets.area: References to Real Life People, Groups, and Events
secrets.summary: The Civil Border Patrol is based on the currently active Minutemen Project and the now defunct Minuteman Civil Defense Corps, both groups of private citizens extrajudicially monitoring the US-Mexico border for illegal immigrants. The name of the mission Minute Man Blues, during which Trevor is tasked with taking down the Civil Border Patrol, references this. By proxy, the Civil Border Patrol's leader, Joe, is based...

secrets.title: Murat Kurnaz
secrets.area: References to Real Life People, Groups, and Events
secrets.summary: The character Ferdinand Kerimov is possibly inspired by Murat Kurnaz, a Turkish-German student who, in 2001, was arrested in Pakistan and handed over to the United States on false suspicions of being a terrorist. He was held at Guantanamo Bay and repeatedly tortured until 2007, despite having been deemed innocent in 2002.

secrets.title: Nikola Tesla
secrets.area: References to Real Life People, Groups, and Events
secrets.summary: Nikola Avenue and Nikola Place are based on the real-life Tesla Avenue in Los Angeles. Nikola Tesla was a famous 19th and 20th century inventor.

secrets.title: North Hollywood bank robbery
secrets.area: References to Real Life People, Groups, and Events
secrets.summary: The Paleto Score is likely inspired by the 1997 North Hollywood bank robbery, during which two heavily armed men robbed a Bank of America branch wearing ballistic armor, resulting in a large-scale shootout with responding law enforcement taking place throughout the surrounding streets.

secrets.title: Occupy Wall Street
secrets.area: References to Real Life People, Groups, and Events
secrets.summary: According to Curtis Weaver, there was a sit-in demonstration outside The Exchange in Algonquin, Liberty City, which is a reference to the Occupy Wall Street protest movement that started in New York City in 2011.

secrets.title: Oliver Cromwell
secrets.area: References to Real Life People, Groups, and Events
secrets.summary: As evidenced by the 2023 source code leaks, Hangman Avenue is based on the real-life Cromwell Avenue, named after Oliver Cromwell, whose corpse was posthumously hung.

secrets.title: Osborne Reef Disaster
secrets.area: References to Real Life People, Groups, and Events
secrets.summary: Located underwater near Chumash is a tire graveyard. This is possibly a reference to the Osborne Reef environmental disaster.

secrets.title: Paris Hilton
secrets.area: References to Real Life People, Groups, and Events
secrets.summary: The character Jill Von Crastenburg parodies many young female celebrities known for being overly sexualized while under the age of consent, though she takes heavy inspiration from Paris Hilton, as both of them have an extreme party lifestyle and belong to a family known for a hotel chain named after them.

secrets.title: Playboy Mansion/Greystone Mansion
secrets.area: References to Real Life People, Groups, and Events
secrets.summary: The Richman Mansion, located immediately west of the golf club, is a recreation of two real-life mansions: the in Beverly Hills and the Playboy Mansion in Holmby Hills. The front contains the entryway, porte cochere, and fountain area of the Greystone. In addition, the building's architecture, window locations, etc, are all near-matches to its real-life inspiration. Behind the house is the Playboy Mansion's famous...

secrets.title: Politics
secrets.area: References to Real Life People, Groups, and Events
secrets.summary: The political race between Sue Murry and Jock Cranley is a reference to a stereotypical election between far-left and far-right politicians. Jock Cranley's personality and background is a reference to Republican politicians such as Ronald Reagan, Arnold Schwarzenegger, and Donald Trump (though Trump did not run for office as a Republican until after GTA Vs release) who were formerly Hollywood actors. Sue Murry's...

secrets.title: Procopio
secrets.area: References to Real Life People, Groups, and Events
secrets.summary: Procopio Beach, Procopio Drive, Procopio Promenade, and Procopio Truck Stop are named after the infamous Californian bandit Procopio.

secrets.title: Roy Lichtenstein
secrets.area: References to Real Life People, Groups, and Events
secrets.summary: Vinewood actor Roy Lowenstein is based on pop artist Roy Lichtenstein.

secrets.title: Shaggy 2 Dope
secrets.area: References to Real Life People, Groups, and Events
secrets.summary: The likeness of Wade Hebert is inspired by Shaggy 2 Dope of the Insane Clown Posse. In an interview, he stated that he found it flattering.

secrets.title: Syrian Uprising
secrets.area: References to Real Life People, Groups, and Events
secrets.summary: The Syrian revolution is mentioned by the host of Non-Stop-Pop FM.

secrets.title: Tom Cruise
secrets.area: References to Real Life People, Groups, and Events
secrets.summary: The character Jimmy Boston, an Epsilonist, is likely a parody of actor Tom Cruise, a Scientologist.

secrets.title: Vespucci Street Names
secrets.area: References to Real Life People, Groups, and Events
secrets.summary: Several street names in Vespucci are named after famous explorers. *Cortes Street is named after the Spanish conquistador Hernán Cortés. *Magellan Avenue is named after the Portuguese explorer Ferdinand Magellan. *Vitus Street is named after the Russian navy officer Vitus Bering.

secrets.title: Walt Disney
secrets.area: References to Real Life People, Groups, and Events
secrets.summary: The unseen character Fred Quincy, founder of Fred's Pictures, is a parody of Walt Disney, founder of the Disney Brothers Cartoon Studio.

secrets.title: Wow! Signal
secrets.area: References to Real Life People, Groups, and Events
secrets.summary: Beam Me Up is an art installation near Sandy Shores, consisting of a hillside being painted and engraved with many words and pictures relating to aliens and UFOs. One of the engravings is '6EQUJ5'. This is a reference to the famous Wow! signal, a mysterious and controversial radio signal from space detected in 1977 that many believe originated from an artificial interstellar source.
